edit.description: Four shipped guidance strings still promise the read wording 0061 retired: `skill`'s `globValid("paths")` (~:1525, "until Claude reads a file its globs match"), `skill`'s `mentionReachable` (~:1531), `rule`'s `globValid("paths")` (~:1641, "scope the rule to matching files") and `rule`'s `mentionReachable` (~:1651) — plus `ruleDefaultContract`'s own doc-comment (~:1622, "rules load when Claude reads a matching file"). Each takes the file-tool wording, and each `mention-reachable` guidance states what the judgment cannot see: a shell or search read opens no gate. The two `mentionReachable` cites gain the probe (probed on Claude Code 2.1.281, 2026-09-24) beside the retrieval date already there.
`mentionReachable`'s own API doc (~:215) carries the same retired wording — "channel until the agent reads a matching file" — and is the surface an author reads before the guidance ever fires.

The embedded lock carries the same four guidance strings (~:873 and ~:892 for `rule`, ~:1097 and ~:1106 for `skill`). Regenerated, never hand-edited: re-run the memberless emit the lock's own header and `tests/builtin_lock_frozen.rs` describe, so the embedded rows and the SDK stay byte-identical.

The second checked-in derived lock, and the one no file name announces: the example harness's program imports the shipped `skill` default contract, so two of the four rows live here too — `skill.glob-valid.paths` (:299) and `skill.mention-reachable.paths` (:308, whose `cite` gains the 2.1.281 probe beside the retrieval date). Its `rule` kind row rides its own contract, so no rule clause row is here to move. Regenerated, never hand-edited: vendor `@dtmd/temper` into `examples/base-harness/.temper/node_modules` (gitignored, never committed) the way `tests/common/mod.rs::vendor_sdk` (:126) does, then `cargo run -- emit --into examples/base-harness/.temper`.

`emit_program_runs_the_shipped_example_harness` (:2420) re-emits the example's own program into a temp copy and byte-compares its lock against the committed one, so it is the gate the fourth file answers to. Its remedy string (:2459, :2483) names only `cargo run -- emit --into examples/base-harness/.temper` and omits the vendoring that run needs, so the message cannot be followed as written — complete it with that prerequisite, having just run it. Wording of the failure message only: no assertion, fixture, or scope changes.

summary: A path gate opens on a file tool, not a shell read — four shipped `paths` guidance strings and the `mention-reachable` API doc still promise "until Claude reads a matching file".

tests.asserts: the embedded lock's declaration rows still byte-match `@dtmd/temper/claude-code`'s memberless emit after the guidance strings move — the mechanical agreement that proves the lock was regenerated, not hand-edited
`emit_program_runs_the_shipped_example_harness` — the example's committed lock byte-matches what its own program now emits, so the second derived lock moved with the SDK instead of drifting

acceptance: `pnpm --dir sdk test` and `cargo test` green — `builtin_lock_frozen` and `emit_program_runs_the_shipped_example_harness` are the two derived locks' currency gates, one per lock; `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
